title: Initialization of Insights View for Functional Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view correctly initializes and renders for functional test results
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights view component properly initializes and renders when functional test results are available
prerequisites:
1. Functional tests have been executed and results are available in the system
2. User has proper access rights to view test insights
3. Insights view feature is enabled for the project
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the test insights dashboard
2. Select the 'Functional Tests' category or filter
3. Wait for the insights view to initialize and load
4. Observe the rendering of all UI components for functional test insights
expectedResult:
1. The Insights view should initialize without errors
2. All UI components should render correctly including summary statistics, charts, and data visualizations
3. Page should display a loading indicator while data is being fetched
4. Once loaded, functional test data should be visible in the insights view
automationApproach: Playwright UI test with snapshot comparisons and DOM verification
testData: Previously executed functional test results with a mix of passed, failed, and skipped tests

title: Integration with Existing Test Types in Insights View
description: Verify that the functional test insights correctly integrate with existing unit, integration, and API test insights
testDescription: This test validates that functional test insights properly coexist and integrate with previously implemented insights for unit, integration, and API tests
prerequisites:
1. Results from all test types (unit, integration, API, and functional) are available
2. Insights view is already implemented for unit, integration, and API tests
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the test insights dashboard
2. Verify that a navigation/filter option for functional tests exists alongside other test types
3. Switch between different test type views (unit, integration, API, functional)
4. Verify data consistency across different test type views
5. Test any aggregate views that combine metrics from different test types
expectedResult:
1. A clear option to view functional test insights should exist in the navigation
2. Switching between test types should maintain consistent UI layout and interaction patterns
3. Aggregate views should correctly include data from functional tests
4. No interference or data corruption should occur between different test type insights
automationApproach: Playwright test verifying navigation elements, data persistence across views, and UI consistency
testData: Test results from all test types (unit, integration, API, and functional)

title: Data Visualization Components for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that all data visualization components correctly represent functional test data
testDescription: This test validates that charts, graphs, and metrics accurately represent functional test results data
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results with comprehensive data are available
2. Insights view is accessible and functional
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the functional test insights view
2. Identify all data visualization components (charts, graphs, tables, metrics)
3. For each component:
   a. Verify it displays data correctly
   b. Interact with the component (hover, click, filter)
   c. Validate that the displayed data matches the raw test results
4. Test any tooltips or additional information displays
5. Check that legends and axes are correctly labeled
expectedResult:
1. All charts, graphs, and metrics should accurately represent the functional test data
2. Interactive elements should work correctly (tooltips, drill-downs, filters)
3. Visualizations should be properly labeled and include units where applicable
4. The data displayed should match the raw functional test results
5. Visual components should adjust appropriately for different data sets
automationApproach: Playwright tests with data validation against known test results and visual verification of chart elements
testData: Various functional test result sets with different distributions of passes, failures, and edge cases

title: Filtering and Sorting Capabilities in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that users can filter and sort functional test insights data effectively
testDescription: This test validates the filtering, sorting, and search capabilities specific to functional test insights
prerequisites:
1. Substantial functional test results data is available in the system
2. Insights view for functional tests is accessible
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the functional test insights view
2. Test each available filter option (by test status, by test category, by date range, etc.)
3. Apply multiple filters simultaneously and verify results
4. Test sorting options on applicable data tables or lists
5. Use search functionality to find specific tests
6. Clear filters and verify return to default view
7. Test any saved filter functionality if available
expectedResult:
1. Each filter should correctly limit the displayed data according to the filter criteria
2. Multiple filters should work in conjunction (AND logic)
3. Sorting should reorder the data accurately based on the selected column/criteria
4. Search should find and highlight relevant test results
5. Clearing filters should restore the full data set
6. UI should provide clear indication of active filters
automationApproach: Playwright UI tests targeting filter controls with data validation of filtered results
riskLevel: Medium - User experience and data access
testData: Large set of varied functional test results to enable meaningful filtering and sorting tests

title: Error Handling and Edge Cases in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that the insights view properly handles error conditions and edge cases for functional test data
testDescription: This test validates the error handling capabilities and behavior with unusual data patterns in the functional test insights view
prerequisites:
1. Access to manipulate test result data or mock responses
2. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the functional test insights view
2. Test behavior with the following conditions:
   a. No functional test results available
   b. Extremely large numbers of test results
   c. All tests passing (100% success)
   d. All tests failing (0% success)
   e. Malformed test result data
   f. Network failure during data loading
3. Verify error messages and fallback displays
4. Test recovery after error conditions resolve
expectedResult:
1. No data scenario should display an appropriate empty state message
2. Large data sets should load with pagination or virtualization without UI freezing
3. Edge case data distributions should display correctly without visual glitches
4. Malformed data should be handled gracefully with appropriate error messages
5. Network failures should trigger retry mechanisms or clear error states
6. System should recover when errors are resolved without requiring full page refresh
automationApproach: Playwright tests with mocked API responses to simulate various error conditions and data patterns
riskLevel: High - System stability under unusual conditions
testData: Specially crafted data sets to trigger edge cases and error conditions

title: Responsiveness of Insights View Across Different Screen Sizes
description: Verify that the functional test insights view is responsive and displays correctly across various device sizes and screen resolutions
testDescription: This test validates that the functional test insights view adapts appropriately to different viewport sizes and maintains usability across devices
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results are available in the system
2. Insights view for functional tests is implemented and accessible
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the functional test insights view
2. Test the view at the following viewport sizes:
   a. Desktop (1920x1080)
   b. Laptop (1366x768)
   c. Tablet (768x1024)
   d. Mobile (375x667)
3. For each viewport size:
   a. Check that all visualization components render correctly
   b. Verify navigation elements remain accessible
   c. Test interactive elements (filters, dropdowns, buttons)
   d. Ensure data remains readable and charts are appropriately sized
expectedResult:
1. The insights view should adjust layout according to the screen size
2. All critical data should be visible without horizontal scrolling on each device
3. Interactive components should remain functional at all viewport sizes
4. Charts and visualizations should resize appropriately without data loss
5. Mobile view should offer touch-friendly controls and readable text
automationApproach: Playwright tests with viewport manipulation and visual comparison across different screen sizes
testData: Standard functional test results data to be viewed across different screen configurations

title: Accessibility Compliance of Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that the insights view for functional tests meets accessibility standards and works with assistive technologies
testDescription: This test validates that the functional test insights view complies with accessibility guidelines and is usable by people with disabilities
prerequisites:
1. Functional test insights view is fully implemented
2. Accessibility testing tools are integrated with Playwright
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the functional test insights view
2. Run automated accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA standards)
3. Test keyboard navigation throughout the insights view
4. Verify screen reader compatibility by navigating with screen reader enabled
5. Check color contrast ratios for all text and visual elements
6. Verify that all interactive elements have appropriate aria attributes
7. Test focus management throughout the UI components
expectedResult:
1. Automated accessibility audit should pass with no critical or high-severity issues
2. All functionality should be accessible via keyboard navigation
3. Screen readers should properly announce all relevant content and state changes
4. Color contrast should meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
5. All interactive elements should have appropriate aria labels and roles
6. Focus should be visible and follow a logical path through the interface
automationApproach: Playwright with accessibility testing plugins (axe-core), keyboard navigation simulation, and screen reader compatibility tests
testData: Standard functional test results with focus on testing accessibility features

title: Export and Sharing Capabilities for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that users can export and share functional test insights data in various formats
testDescription: This test validates the ability to export, download, and share functional test insights in different formats and through various mechanisms
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results are available in the system
2. Insights view with export functionality is implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the functional test insights view
2. Locate and test each export option:
   a. Export to CSV/Excel
   b. Export to PDF
   c. Generate shareable link
   d. Email report option (if available)
3. For each export format:
   a. Verify the export process completes successfully
   b. Open the exported file to validate data accuracy
   c. Check that formatting and visualization are appropriate for the format
4. Test sharing options:
   a. Generate and test shareable links
   b. Verify permissions are applied correctly to shared content
expectedResult:
1. All export options should function correctly without errors
2. Exported data should match what's displayed in the UI
3. CSV/Excel exports should contain all relevant data in a structured format
4. PDF exports should maintain visual fidelity of charts and tables
5. Shareable links should open the correct view with appropriate permissions
6. Large data sets should export completely without truncation
automationApproach: Playwright tests for triggering exports and verifying download completion, with file content validation where possible
riskLevel: Medium - Data portability and reporting capabilities
testData: Comprehensive functional test results with various metrics and visualizations suitable for export testing

title: Historical Trending of Functional Test Results in Insights View
description: Verify that the insights view properly displays historical trends and comparisons of functional test results over time
testDescription: This test validates that the insights view can display and analyze trends in functional test performance across multiple test runs and time periods
prerequisites:
1. Historical functional test data spanning multiple time periods is available
2. Insights view with trending capabilities is implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the functional test insights view
2. Locate and select trend analysis or historical comparison features
3. Test different time period selections (last week, last month, custom range)
4. Verify trend visualizations for key metrics (pass rate, execution time, flakiness)
5. Test comparison between specific test runs or time periods
6. Check for anomaly highlighting or regression indicators
7. Validate any statistical analysis features (performance degradation, improvement trends)
expectedResult:
1. Historical data should load correctly for selected time periods
2. Trend charts should accurately display changes in metrics over time
3. Comparison features should clearly highlight differences between periods
4. Statistical indicators should correctly identify significant changes
5. Date range selectors should function properly and affect displayed data
6. Time-based filtering should work consistently with other filters
7. Performance trends should be visually clear and accompanied by relevant metrics
automationApproach: Playwright tests with time-based data sets and verification of trend calculations and visualizations
riskLevel: Medium - Analytical accuracy and data interpretation
testData: Historical functional test results spanning multiple time periods with notable trends and changes

title: Cross-Browser Compatibility of Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that the functional test insights view works consistently across different browsers and browser versions
testDescription: This test validates that all features of the functional test insights view function correctly and appear consistent across various browsers
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results are available in the system
2. Insights view is implemented and accessible
3. Playwright is configured for cross-browser testing
stepsToPerform:
1. Configure test to run on multiple browsers:
   a. Chrome (latest)
   b. Firefox (latest)
   c. Safari (latest)
   d. Edge (latest)
2. For each browser, perform these checks:
   a. Navigate to the functional test insights view
   b. Verify that all visualization components render correctly
   c. Test interactive elements (filters, dropdowns, tooltips)
   d. Check responsiveness and layout consistency
   e. Test data loading and refresh capabilities
   f. Verify animations and transitions work as expected
expectedResult:
1. All insights view features should work consistently across all tested browsers
2. Visual appearance should be nearly identical between browsers
3. No browser-specific errors should appear in the console
4. Interactive elements should behave consistently across browsers
5. Data visualization components should render correctly in all browsers
6. Performance should be acceptable across all browsers
automationApproach: Playwright multi-browser tests with consistent assertions and visual comparisons across browser environments
riskLevel: High - Wide audience accessibility and consistent experience
testData: Standard functional test results dataset to be displayed consistently across browsers

title: Real-time Update of Functional Test Insights During Test Execution
description: Verify that the Insights view updates in real-time as functional tests are being executed
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights dashboard updates dynamically as functional tests are running, providing real-time visibility into test execution progress
prerequisites:
1. Functional test framework is configured for real-time reporting
2. Insights view is implemented with real-time update capability
3. Test execution environment is set up
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Initiate a functional test run from the CI/CD pipeline or test runner
3. Keep the Insights view open during test execution
4. Monitor updates to the dashboard as tests complete
5. Note the frequency of updates and accuracy of information
6. Verify that completed tests appear in real-time without manual refresh
expectedResult:
1. The Insights view should update automatically as tests are completed
2. Progress indicators should accurately reflect the current state of test execution
3. Completed tests should appear in the dashboard with their correct status without requiring manual refresh
4. The real-time updates should not affect performance or usability of the dashboard
5. If a test fails, it should be immediately visible in the dashboard
automationApproach: Playwright test that initiates test runs and monitors DOM changes in the Insights view to verify real-time updates
testData: Ongoing functional test execution with various test durations and outcomes

title: Customizable Dashboard for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that users can customize the Functional Test Insights dashboard according to their preferences
testDescription: This test validates that users can personalize their Functional Test Insights view by adding, removing, and rearranging visualization components
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results are available in the system
2. Insights view is implemented with customization capabilities
3. User has appropriate permissions to customize the dashboard
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate and activate the dashboard customization mode
3. Test adding new visualization components (charts, tables, metrics)
4. Remove existing components from the dashboard
5. Rearrange components by drag and drop
6. Resize visualization components
7. Save the customized dashboard configuration
8. Reload the page and verify that customizations persist
9. Reset dashboard to default settings
expectedResult:
1. Users should be able to enter a customization mode for the dashboard
2. Adding new components should present a selection of available visualization types
3. Components should be removable without affecting other parts of the dashboard
4. Drag and drop rearrangement should work smoothly
5. Component resizing should maintain data integrity and visualization quality
6. Customizations should persist across sessions after saving
7. Reset option should restore the default dashboard configuration
automationApproach: Playwright test sequence for dashboard manipulation with verification of DOM changes and persistence of customizations
testData: Standard functional test results with various metrics suitable for different visualization types

title: Advanced Analytics and Machine Learning Insights for Functional Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view provides advanced analytics and machine learning-based insights for functional test results
testDescription: This test validates that the system can analyze functional test data to provide intelligent insights, such as identifying flaky tests, predicting failures, and suggesting optimization opportunities
prerequisites:
1. Sufficient historical functional test data is available for analysis
2. Advanced analytics features are implemented in the Insights view
3. Machine learning models for test analysis are trained and active
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate the advanced analytics or AI insights section
3. Check for presence of key analytics features:
   a. Flaky test identification
   b. Failure prediction
   c. Test execution time analysis
   d. Optimization recommendations
4. Verify each analytics feature with known test data patterns
5. Validate that insights are actionable and provide relevant context
expectedResult:
1. The system should identify patterns in test execution data and display relevant insights
2. Flaky tests should be correctly identified based on historical inconsistent results
3. Predictive analytics should highlight tests at risk of failure
4. Performance trends should be analyzed to suggest optimization opportunities
5. Machine learning insights should provide actionable recommendations
6. Advanced analytics should be clearly distinguished from raw data reporting
automationApproach: Playwright test with predefined test data sets that should trigger specific analytics insights, verifying their presence and accuracy
testData: Historical functional test data with known patterns of flakiness, performance issues, and failure trends

title: Integration with CI/CD Pipeline Metrics in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that the Functional Test Insights view integrates with CI/CD pipeline metrics to provide context-aware test reporting
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Test Insights view can correlate test results with CI/CD pipeline events and metrics, providing a comprehensive view of software quality in the development lifecycle
prerequisites:
1. Functional tests are integrated with a CI/CD pipeline
2. CI/CD system provides accessible API for metrics
3. Insights view has CI/CD integration features implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate CI/CD integration features or pipeline view
3. Verify correlation between test results and pipeline events
4. Check visualization of test results in the context of build/deployment events
5. Test filtering results by pipeline, branch, or deployment
6. Validate linking between test failures and specific code changes or commits
7. Verify pipeline health metrics that incorporate functional test results
expectedResult:
1. Test results should be contextualized with CI/CD pipeline information
2. Users should be able to see which build/deployment contains specific test results
3. Filtering by CI/CD parameters should work correctly
4. Failed tests should link to relevant code changes or commits where possible
5. Pipeline health metrics should accurately incorporate functional test status
6. The integration should provide clear visibility of test results throughout the CI/CD process
automationApproach: Playwright test verifying the presence and accuracy of CI/CD integration points in the Insights view, with mock CI/CD data if needed
testData: Functional test results with associated CI/CD pipeline metadata, build information, and commit references

title: Collaboration and Commenting Features in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that users can collaborate and communicate within the Functional Test Insights view through comments, shares, and notifications
testDescription: This test validates the collaborative features that allow team members to discuss, share, and act upon functional test results directly within the Insights interface
prerequisites:
1. Multiple user accounts with access to the Insights view
2. Functional test results available in the system
3. Collaboration features implemented in the Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate and test comment functionality on specific test results or visualizations
3. Tag other users in comments and verify notifications
4. Create and share custom views of the dashboard with specific filters
5. Subscribe to notifications for test failures or status changes
6. Verify email or in-app notifications when commented tests change status
7. Test collaborative analysis features like shared annotations or highlights
expectedResult:
1. Users should be able to add comments to specific test results or visualizations
2. Comments should persist and be visible to other team members
3. User tagging should work correctly and trigger notifications
4. Custom views should be shareable via links with proper permissions
5. Subscriptions to test results should trigger appropriate notifications
6. Collaborative features should not interfere with the primary insights functionality
7. All collaboration actions should be tracked with user attribution
automationApproach: Playwright tests with multiple simulated users to verify interaction, notification, and sharing features across accounts
testData: Functional test results that require team discussion, with multiple test user accounts for collaboration testing
